eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

oauth_configuration.description: **Beta:** Optional configuration for managing an OAuth authorization flow controlled by Access. When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

dynamic_client_registration.description: Settings for OAuth dynamic client registration.

allow_any_on_localhost.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on localhost.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.
Whether the OAuth configuration is enabled for this application. When set to `false`, Access will not handle OAuth for this application. Defaults to `true` if omitted.

access_token_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the access token. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

session_duration.description: The duration of the OAuth session. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

id.description: UUID.

allow_authenticate_via_warp.description: When set to true, users can authenticate to this application using their WARP session.  When set to false this application will always require direct IdP authentication. This setting always overrides the organization setting for WARP authentication.

allow_iframe.description: Enables loading application content in an iFrame.

allowed_idps.description: The identity providers your users can select when connecting to this application. Defaults to all IdPs configured in your account.

items.description: The identity providers selected for application.

app_launcher_visible.description: Displays the application in the App Launcher.

auto_redirect_to_identity.description: When set to `true`, users skip the identity provider selection step during login. You must specify only one identity provider in allowed_idps.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

custom_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing identity-based rules.

custom_non_identity_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing non-identity rules.

custom_pages.description: The custom pages that will be displayed when applicable for this application

items.description: The custom pages selected for application.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker that Access will secure. All requests routed to the specified Worker, including its preview deployments, will be protected. The `preview_worker` and `public` destination types takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for the Worker's previews or specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Worker destination

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments Access will secure. Only requests routed to the preview deployments of the specified Worker will be protected. The `public` destination type takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Preview Worker destination

oneOf.description: Protects all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access, including their preview deployments. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, `all_preview_workers`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Workers destination

oneOf.description: Protects the preview deployments of all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.

domain.description: The primary hostname and path secured by Access. This domain will be displayed if the app is visible in the App Launcher.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

logo_url.description: The image URL for the logo shown in the App Launcher dashboard.

allowed_authenticators.description: Lists the MFA methods that users can authenticate with.

mfa_disabled.description: Indicates whether to disable MFA for this resource. This option is available at the application and policy level.

session_duration.description: Defines the duration of an MFA session. Must be in minutes (m) or hours (h). Minimum: 0m. Maximum: 720h (30 days). Examples:`5m` or `24h`.

name.description: The name of the application.

oauth_configuration.description: **Beta:** Optional configuration for managing an OAuth authorization flow controlled by Access. When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

dynamic_client_registration.description: Settings for OAuth dynamic client registration.

allow_any_on_localhost.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on localhost.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.
Whether the OAuth configuration is enabled for this application. When set to `false`, Access will not handle OAuth for this application. Defaults to `true` if omitted.

access_token_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the access token. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

session_duration.description: The duration of the OAuth session. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

custom_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing identity-based rules.

custom_non_identity_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing non-identity rules.

custom_pages.description: The custom pages that will be displayed when applicable for this application

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

oneOf.title: Public destination

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

oneOf.description: A MCP server id configured in ai-controls. Access will secure the MCP server if accessed through a MCP portal.

mcp_server_id.description: The MCP server id configured in ai-controls.

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker that Access will secure. All requests routed to the specified Worker, including its preview deployments, will be protected. The `preview_worker` and `public` destination types takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for the Worker's previews or specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Worker destination

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments Access will secure. Only requests routed to the preview deployments of the specified Worker will be protected. The `public` destination type takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Preview Worker destination

oneOf.description: Protects all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access, including their preview deployments. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, `all_preview_workers`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Workers destination

oneOf.description: Protects the preview deployments of all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Preview Workers destination

domain.description: The primary hostname and path secured by Access. This domain will be displayed if the app is visible in the App Launcher.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

logo_url.description: The image URL for the logo shown in the App Launcher dashboard.

allowed_authenticators.description: Lists the MFA methods that users can authenticate with.

mfa_disabled.description: Indicates whether to disable MFA for this resource. This option is available at the application and policy level.

session_duration.description: Defines the duration of an MFA session. Must be in minutes (m) or hours (h). Minimum: 0m. Maximum: 720h (30 days). Examples:`5m` or `24h`.

name.description: The name of the application.

oauth_configuration.description: **Beta:** Optional configuration for managing an OAuth authorization flow controlled by Access. When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

dynamic_client_registration.description: Settings for OAuth dynamic client registration.

allow_any_on_localhost.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on localhost.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.
Whether the OAuth configuration is enabled for this application. When set to `false`, Access will not handle OAuth for this application. Defaults to `true` if omitted.

access_token_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the access token. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

session_duration.description: The duration of the OAuth session. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

allow_authenticate_via_warp.description: When set to true, users can authenticate to this application using their WARP session.  When set to false this application will always require direct IdP authentication. This setting always overrides the organization setting for WARP authentication.

allowed_idps.description: The identity providers your users can select when connecting to this application. Defaults to all IdPs configured in your account.

items.description: The identity providers selected for application.

auto_redirect_to_identity.description: When set to `true`, users skip the identity provider selection step during login. You must specify only one identity provider in allowed_idps.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

custom_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing identity-based rules.

custom_pages.description: The custom pages that will be displayed when applicable for this application

items.description: The custom pages selected for application.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

oneOf.title: Public destination

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

oneOf.description: A MCP server id configured in ai-controls. Access will secure the MCP server if accessed through a MCP portal.

mcp_server_id.description: The MCP server id configured in ai-controls.

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker that Access will secure. All requests routed to the specified Worker, including its preview deployments, will be protected. The `preview_worker` and `public` destination types takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for the Worker's previews or specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Worker destination

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments Access will secure. Only requests routed to the preview deployments of the specified Worker will be protected. The `public` destination type takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Preview Worker destination

oneOf.description: Protects all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access, including their preview deployments. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, `all_preview_workers`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Workers destination

oneOf.description: Protects the preview deployments of all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Preview Workers destination

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

allow_authenticate_via_warp.description: When set to true, users can authenticate to this application using their WARP session.  When set to false this application will always require direct IdP authentication. This setting always overrides the organization setting for WARP authentication.

auto_redirect_to_identity.description: When set to `true`, users skip the identity provider selection step during login. You must specify only one identity provider in allowed_idps.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

id.description: UUID.

allow_authenticate_via_warp.description: When set to true, users can authenticate to this application using their WARP session.  When set to false this application will always require direct IdP authentication. This setting always overrides the organization setting for WARP authentication.

allow_iframe.description: Enables loading application content in an iFrame.

allowed_idps.description: The identity providers your users can select when connecting to this application. Defaults to all IdPs configured in your account.

items.description: The identity providers selected for application.

app_launcher_visible.description: Displays the application in the App Launcher.

auto_redirect_to_identity.description: When set to `true`, users skip the identity provider selection step during login. You must specify only one identity provider in allowed_idps.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

custom_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing identity-based rules.

custom_non_identity_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing non-identity rules.

custom_pages.description: The custom pages that will be displayed when applicable for this application

items.description: The custom pages selected for application.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

oneOf.title: Public destination

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

oneOf.description: A MCP server id configured in ai-controls. Access will secure the MCP server if accessed through a MCP portal.

mcp_server_id.description: The MCP server id configured in ai-controls.

oneOf.title: Via MCP Server Portal destination

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker that Access will secure. All requests routed to the specified Worker, including its preview deployments, will be protected. The `preview_worker` and `public` destination types takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for the Worker's previews or specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Worker destination

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments Access will secure. Only requests routed to the preview deployments of the specified Worker will be protected. The `public` destination type takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Preview Worker destination

oneOf.description: Protects all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access, including their preview deployments. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, `all_preview_workers`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Workers destination

oneOf.description: Protects the preview deployments of all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Preview Workers destination

domain.description: The primary hostname and path secured by Access. This domain will be displayed if the app is visible in the App Launcher.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

logo_url.description: The image URL for the logo shown in the App Launcher dashboard.

allowed_authenticators.description: Lists the MFA methods that users can authenticate with.

mfa_disabled.description: Indicates whether to disable MFA for this resource. This option is available at the application and policy level.

session_duration.description: Defines the duration of an MFA session. Must be in minutes (m) or hours (h). Minimum: 0m. Maximum: 720h (30 days). Examples:`5m` or `24h`.

name.description: The name of the application.

oauth_configuration.description: **Beta:** Optional configuration for managing an OAuth authorization flow controlled by Access. When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

dynamic_client_registration.description: Settings for OAuth dynamic client registration.

allow_any_on_localhost.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on localhost.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.
Whether the OAuth configuration is enabled for this application. When set to `false`, Access will not handle OAuth for this application. Defaults to `true` if omitted.

access_token_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the access token. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

session_duration.description: The duration of the OAuth session. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

deactivate_on_delete.description: If false, propagates DELETE requests to the target application for SCIM resources. If true, sets 'active' to false on the SCIM resource. Note: Some targets do not support DELETE operations.

enabled.description: Whether SCIM provisioning is turned on for this application.

idp_uid.description: The UID of the IdP to use as the source for SCIM resources to provision to this application.

mappings.description: A list of mappings to apply to SCIM resources before provisioning them in this application. These can transform or filter the resources to be provisioned.

items.description: Transformations and filters applied to resources before they are provisioned in the remote SCIM service.

enabled.description: Whether or not this mapping is enabled.

filter.description: A [SCIM filter expression](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7644#section-3.4.2.2) that matches resources that should be provisioned to this application.

operations.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to creates, updates, or deletes.

create.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to create (POST) operations.

delete.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to DELETE operations.

update.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to update (PATCH/PUT) operations.

schema.description: Which SCIM resource type this mapping applies to.

strictness.description: The level of adherence to outbound resource schemas when provisioning to this mapping. ‘Strict’ removes unknown values, while ‘passthrough’ passes unknown values to the target.

transform_jsonata.description: A [JSONata](https://jsonata.org/) expression that transforms the resource before provisioning it in the application.

remote_uri.description: The base URI for the application's SCIM-compatible API.

self_hosted_domains.description: List of public domains that Access will secure. This field is deprecated in favor of `destinations` and will be supported until **November 21, 2025.** If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

items.description: A domain that Access will secure.

service_auth_401_redirect.description: Returns a 401 status code when the request is blocked by a Service Auth policy.

session_duration.description: The amount of time that tokens issued for this application will be valid. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are: ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h. Note: unsupported for infrastructure type applications.

tags.description: The tags you want assigned to an application. Tags are used to filter applications in the App Launcher dashboard.

items.description: The tag associated with an application.

use_clientless_isolation_app_launcher_ur.description:

This allows users to access private domains without connecting to Gateway. The option requires
Clientless Browser Isolation to be set up with policies that allow users of this application.

allOf.description: The policies that Access applies to the application.

allow_authenticate_via_warp.description: When set to true, users can authenticate to this application using their WARP session.  When set to false this application will always require direct IdP authentication. This setting always overrides the organization setting for WARP authentication.

allow_iframe.description: Enables loading application content in an iFrame.

allowed_idps.description: The identity providers your users can select when connecting to this application. Defaults to all IdPs configured in your account.

items.description: The identity providers selected for application.

app_launcher_visible.description: Displays the application in the App Launcher.

auto_redirect_to_identity.description: When set to `true`, users skip the identity provider selection step during login. You must specify only one identity provider in allowed_idps.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

custom_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing identity-based rules.

custom_non_identity_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing non-identity rules.

custom_pages.description: The custom pages that will be displayed when applicable for this application

items.description: The custom pages selected for application.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

oneOf.title: Public destination

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

oneOf.description: A MCP server id configured in ai-controls. Access will secure the MCP server if accessed through a MCP portal.

mcp_server_id.description: The MCP server id configured in ai-controls.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker to protect with Access.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments to protect with Access.

The `worker`, `preview_worker`, `all_preview_workers`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Workers destination

The `worker`, `preview_worker`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.

domain.description: The primary hostname and path secured by Access. This domain will be displayed if the app is visible in the App Launcher.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

name.description: The name of the application.

oauth_configuration.description: **Beta:** Optional configuration for managing an OAuth authorization flow controlled by Access. When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

dynamic_client_registration.description: Settings for OAuth dynamic client registration.

allow_any_on_localhost.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on localhost.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.
Whether the OAuth configuration is enabled for this application. When set to `false`, Access will not handle OAuth for this application. Defaults to `true` if omitted.

access_token_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the access token. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

session_duration.description: The duration of the OAuth session. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

strictness.description: The level of adherence to outbound resource schemas when provisioning to this mapping. ‘Strict’ removes unknown values, while ‘passthrough’ passes unknown values to the target.

transform_jsonata.description: A [JSONata](https://jsonata.org/) expression that transforms the resource before provisioning it in the application.

remote_uri.description: The base URI for the application's SCIM-compatible API.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker to protect with Access.

The `worker`, `preview_worker`, `all_preview_workers`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Workers destination

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

domain.description: The primary hostname and path secured by Access. This domain will be displayed if the app is visible in the App Launcher.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

logo_url.description: The image URL for the logo shown in the App Launcher dashboard.

allowed_authenticators.description: Lists the MFA methods that users can authenticate with.

mfa_disabled.description: Indicates whether to disable MFA for this resource. This option is available at the application and policy level.

session_duration.description: Defines the duration of an MFA session. Must be in minutes (m) or hours (h). Minimum: 0m. Maximum: 720h (30 days). Examples:`5m` or `24h`.

name.description: The name of the application.

oauth_configuration.description: **Beta:** Optional configuration for managing an OAuth authorization flow controlled by Access. When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

dynamic_client_registration.description: Settings for OAuth dynamic client registration.

allow_any_on_localhost.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on localhost.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.
Whether the OAuth configuration is enabled for this application. When set to `false`, Access will not handle OAuth for this application. Defaults to `true` if omitted.

access_token_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the access token. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

session_duration.description: The duration of the OAuth session. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

enabled.description: Whether SCIM provisioning is turned on for this application.

idp_uid.description: The UID of the IdP to use as the source for SCIM resources to provision to this application.

mappings.description: A list of mappings to apply to SCIM resources before provisioning them in this application. These can transform or filter the resources to be provisioned.

items.description: Transformations and filters applied to resources before they are provisioned in the remote SCIM service.

enabled.description: Whether or not this mapping is enabled.

filter.description: A [SCIM filter expression](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7644#section-3.4.2.2) that matches resources that should be provisioned to this application.

operations.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to creates, updates, or deletes.

create.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to create (POST) operations.

delete.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to DELETE operations.

update.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to update (PATCH/PUT) operations.

schema.description: Which SCIM resource type this mapping applies to.

strictness.description: The level of adherence to outbound resource schemas when provisioning to this mapping. ‘Strict’ removes unknown values, while ‘passthrough’ passes unknown values to the target.

transform_jsonata.description: A [JSONata](https://jsonata.org/) expression that transforms the resource before provisioning it in the application.

remote_uri.description: The base URI for the application's SCIM-compatible API.

allow_authenticate_via_warp.description: When set to true, users can authenticate to this application using their WARP session.  When set to false this application will always require direct IdP authentication. This setting always overrides the organization setting for WARP authentication.

allow_iframe.description: Enables loading application content in an iFrame.

allowed_idps.description: The identity providers your users can select when connecting to this application. Defaults to all IdPs configured in your account.

items.description: The identity providers selected for application.

app_launcher_visible.description: Displays the application in the App Launcher.

auto_redirect_to_identity.description: When set to `true`, users skip the identity provider selection step during login. You must specify only one identity provider in allowed_idps.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

custom_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing identity-based rules.

custom_non_identity_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing non-identity rules.

custom_pages.description: The custom pages that will be displayed when applicable for this application

items.description: The custom pages selected for application.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

logo_url.description: The image URL for the logo shown in the App Launcher dashboard.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

deactivate_on_delete.description: If false, propagates DELETE requests to the target application for SCIM resources. If true, sets 'active' to false on the SCIM resource. Note: Some targets do not support DELETE operations.

enabled.description: Whether SCIM provisioning is turned on for this application.

idp_uid.description: The UID of the IdP to use as the source for SCIM resources to provision to this application.

mappings.description: A list of mappings to apply to SCIM resources before provisioning them in this application. These can transform or filter the resources to be provisioned.

items.description: Transformations and filters applied to resources before they are provisioned in the remote SCIM service.

enabled.description: Whether or not this mapping is enabled.

filter.description: A [SCIM filter expression](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7644#section-3.4.2.2) that matches resources that should be provisioned to this application.

operations.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to creates, updates, or deletes.

create.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to create (POST) operations.

delete.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to DELETE operations.

update.description: Whether or not this mapping applies to update (PATCH/PUT) operations.

schema.description: Which SCIM resource type this mapping applies to.

strictness.description: The level of adherence to outbound resource schemas when provisioning to this mapping. ‘Strict’ removes unknown values, while ‘passthrough’ passes unknown values to the target.

transform_jsonata.description: A [JSONata](https://jsonata.org/) expression that transforms the resource before provisioning it in the application.

remote_uri.description: The base URI for the application's SCIM-compatible API.

allow_authenticate_via_warp.description: When set to true, users can authenticate to this application using their WARP session.  When set to false this application will always require direct IdP authentication. This setting always overrides the organization setting for WARP authentication.

allow_iframe.description: Enables loading application content in an iFrame.

allowed_idps.description: The identity providers your users can select when connecting to this application. Defaults to all IdPs configured in your account.

items.description: The identity providers selected for application.

app_launcher_visible.description: Displays the application in the App Launcher.

auto_redirect_to_identity.description: When set to `true`, users skip the identity provider selection step during login. You must specify only one identity provider in allowed_idps.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

custom_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing identity-based rules.

custom_non_identity_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing non-identity rules.

custom_pages.description: The custom pages that will be displayed when applicable for this application

items.description: The custom pages selected for application.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

oneOf.title: Public destination

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

oneOf.description: A MCP server id configured in ai-controls. Access will secure the MCP server if accessed through a MCP portal.

mcp_server_id.description: The MCP server id configured in ai-controls.

oneOf.title: Via MCP Server Portal destination

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker that Access will secure. All requests routed to the specified Worker, including its preview deployments, will be protected. The `preview_worker` and `public` destination types takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for the Worker's previews or specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Worker destination

oneOf.description: A specific Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments Access will secure. Only requests routed to the preview deployments of the specified Worker will be protected. The `public` destination type takes precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific paths.

worker_id.description: The ID of the Cloudflare Worker whose preview deployments to protect with Access.

oneOf.title: Preview Worker destination

oneOf.description: Protects all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access, including their preview deployments. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, `all_preview_workers`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Workers destination

oneOf.description: Protects the preview deployments of all Cloudflare Workers on the account with Access. At most one destination of this type can exist per account. The `worker`, `preview_worker`, and `public` destination types take precedence, so you can create separate applications to override the policies for specific Workers, their previews, or specific paths.
oneOf.title: All Preview Workers destination

domain.description: The primary hostname and path secured by Access. This domain will be displayed if the app is visible in the App Launcher.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

logo_url.description: The image URL for the logo shown in the App Launcher dashboard.

allowed_authenticators.description: Lists the MFA methods that users can authenticate with.

mfa_disabled.description: Indicates whether to disable MFA for this resource. This option is available at the application and policy level.

session_duration.description: Defines the duration of an MFA session. Must be in minutes (m) or hours (h). Minimum: 0m. Maximum: 720h (30 days). Examples:`5m` or `24h`.

name.description: The name of the application.

oauth_configuration.description: **Beta:** Optional configuration for managing an OAuth authorization flow controlled by Access. When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

dynamic_client_registration.description: Settings for OAuth dynamic client registration.

allow_any_on_localhost.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on localhost.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.
Whether the OAuth configuration is enabled for this application. When set to `false`, Access will not handle OAuth for this application. Defaults to `true` if omitted.

access_token_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the access token. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

session_duration.description: The duration of the OAuth session. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

decision.description: The action Access will take if a user matches this policy. Infrastructure application policies can only use the Allow action.

exclude.description: Rules evaluated with a NOT logical operator. To match the policy, a user cannot meet any of the Exclude rules.

allow_authenticate_via_warp.description: When set to true, users can authenticate to this application using their WARP session.  When set to false this application will always require direct IdP authentication. This setting always overrides the organization setting for WARP authentication.

allowed_idps.description: The identity providers your users can select when connecting to this application. Defaults to all IdPs configured in your account.

items.description: The identity providers selected for application.

app_launcher_visible.description: Displays the application in the App Launcher.

auto_redirect_to_identity.description: When set to `true`, users skip the identity provider selection step during login. You must specify only one identity provider in allowed_idps.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

custom_deny_message.description: The custom error message shown to a user when they are denied access to the application.

custom_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing identity-based rules.

custom_non_identity_deny_url.description: The custom URL a user is redirected to when they are denied access to the application when failing non-identity rules.

custom_pages.description: The custom pages that will be displayed when applicable for this application

items.description: The custom pages selected for application.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

uri.description: The URI of the destination. Public destinations' URIs can include a domain and path with [wildcards](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/policies/access/app-paths/).

oneOf.title: Public destination

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

oneOf.title: All Workers destination

domain.description: The primary hostname and path secured by Access. This domain will be displayed if the app is visible in the App Launcher.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

logo_url.description: The image URL for the logo shown in the App Launcher dashboard.

allowed_authenticators.description: Lists the MFA methods that users can authenticate with.

mfa_disabled.description: Indicates whether to disable MFA for this resource. This option is available at the application and policy level.

name.description: The name of the application.

oauth_configuration.description: **Beta:** Optional configuration for managing an OAuth authorization flow controlled by Access. When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

dynamic_client_registration.description: Settings for OAuth dynamic client registration.

allow_any_on_localhost.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on localhost.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.
Whether the OAuth configuration is enabled for this application. When set to `false`, Access will not handle OAuth for this application. Defaults to `true` if omitted.

access_token_lifetime.description: The lifetime of the access token. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

session_duration.description: The duration of the OAuth session. Must be in the format `300ms` or `2h45m`. Valid time units are ns, us (or µs), ms, s, m, h.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

allow_credentials.description: When set to `true`, includes credentials (cookies, authorization headers, or TLS client certificates) with requests.

max_age.description: The maximum number of seconds the results of a preflight request can be cached.

destinations.description: List of destinations secured by Access. This supersedes `self_hosted_domains` to allow for more flexibility in defining different types of domains. If `destinations` are provided, then `self_hosted_domains` will be ignored.

oneOf.description: A public hostname that Access will secure. Public destinations support sub-domain and path. Wildcard '*' can be used in the definition.

cidr.description: The CIDR range of the destination. Single IPs will be computed as /32.

hostname.description: The hostname of the destination. Matches a valid SNI served by an HTTPS origin.

l4_protocol.description: The L4 protocol of the destination. When omitted, both UDP and TCP traffic will match.

port_range.description: The port range of the destination. Can be a single port or a range of ports. When omitted, all ports will match.

vnet_id.description: The VNET ID to match the destination. When omitted, all VNETs will match.

eager_redirect_cookie_setting.description: Preemptively sets the Access session cookie on every hostname in a multi-hostname self-hosted application during the initial redirect chain, rather than setting it lazily on first visit. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable the eager redirect cookie behavior.

enable_binding_cookie.description: Enables the binding cookie, which increases security against compromised authorization tokens and CSRF attacks.

http_only_cookie_attribute.description: Enables the HttpOnly cookie attribute, which increases security against XSS attacks.

When set, Access will act as the OAuth authorization server for this application. Only compatible with OAuth clients that support [RFC 8707](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8707) (Resource Indicators for OAuth 2.0). This feature is currently in beta.

allow_any_on_loopback.description: Allows any client with redirect URIs on 127.0.0.1.

allowed_uris.description: The URIs that are allowed as redirect URIs for dynamically registered clients. HTTP and HTTPS paths may end in `/*` to match all sub-paths. Custom-scheme URIs must be explicitly configured and match exactly.

enabled.description: Whether dynamic client registration is enabled.

options_preflight_bypass.description: Allows options preflight requests to bypass Access authentication and go directly to the origin. Cannot turn on if cors_headers is set.

path_cookie_attribute.description: Enables cookie paths to scope an application's JWT to the application path. If disabled, the JWT will scope to the hostname by default

read_service_tokens_from_header.description:
Allows matching Access Service Tokens passed HTTP in a single header with this name.
This works as an alternative to the (CF-Access-Client-Id, CF-Access-Client-Secret) pair of headers.
The header value will be interpreted as a json object similar to:
  {
    "cf-access-client-id": "88bf3b6d86161464f6509f7219099e57.access.example.com",
    "cf-access-client-secret": "bdd31cbc4dec990953e39163fbbb194c93313ca9f0a6e420346af9d326b1d2a5"
  }

same_site_cookie_attribute.description: Sets the SameSite cookie setting, which provides increased security against CSRF attacks.
